title: Business Development and Strategy Graduate
description: The OpportunityWe are seeking a talented Business Development and Strategy Graduate to commence in January 2027. Graduates will join the Boeing Defence Australia Graduate Program in Brisbane in a permanent full-time position, providing a solid career foundation from day one.Our Business Development & Strategy (BD&S) Team play a key role in driving new business based on cutting-edge solutions for the world's leading aerospace company. The work that Boeing does contributes to aviation and aerospace products, technologies and services that make a difference in the lives of people around the world.As a Business Development and Strategy Graduate you will:Work closely with the BD&S team, and our partners, to support the capture of new opportunities for BoeingCoordinate proposal management, plans and schedules for customer campaignsWork closely with multi-disciplinary campaign teams to support development of proposal structure and content including proposal writing and graphicsCommunicate effectively with industry, internal stakeholders, and senior team members, fostering positive relationships and collaboration through clear communication and transparencyYour attitude, motivation, willingness to learn and ability to self-task under supervision will determine your success in our team!Education Tertiary degree qualification in Business, Commerce, Communications, Economics, Finance, Journalism, Law, Marketing or Project Management (or anticipated graduation before January 2027)Eligibility Applicants must be Australian Citizens to meet Defence security requirements. How to apply Please submit your CV together with a cover letter and your university transcript to be considered.Our Graduate Program Our 24-month Graduate Program is designed to equip you with essential skills for a successful transition into full-time work, while also fostering your growth into an experienced professional. Throughout the program, you will engage in professional learning and development, as well as social and collaborative opportunities to expand your Boeing network.While the Graduate Program has defined learning objectives and a structured framework, your individual journey will be tailored in collaboration with your manager, shaped by business needs and your personal professional development goals. To enhance your exposure and learning, you will remain within one business unit for the entire duration of the program, allowing you to immerse yourself in team dynamics and project work. Over these 24 months, you will not only acquire the technical skills necessary for your role but also develop the interpersonal skills that are vital for a fulfilling career.About UsAt Boeing, we connect, protect, explore, and inspire the world through aerospace innovation. As one of Australia's leading prime defence contractors, Boeing Defence Australia supports some of the largest and most complex programs for the customers including the Australian Defence Force to support world- class defence capabilities. Boeing plays an integral role in the region's aerospace and defence industry. We're a leader in advanced manufacturing for commercial airplane components, the development and production of Collaborative Combat Aircraft, communications systems, sustainment, training and services, research and development, and uncrewed systems.Benefits  Competitive Salary & Bonuses: Enjoy a competitive salary along with yearly bonuses.Flexible Work Schedule: Benefit from a hybrid work model, with options for an RDO and WHF 2 days a week.Paid Leave Options: Access various paid leave entitlements to support your personal and family needs.Financial Discounts: Take advantage of discounted health insurance premiums, travel, and retail shopping, along with a nationwide Fitness Passport.Financial Benefits: Explore options for novated leasing and salary sacrifice for superannuation.Career Development: Receive both informal and formal tailored mentorship to accelerate your career growth and design promotional pathways.Recognition Program: Participate in our recognition award program, which acknowledges professional achievements through a points and payment scheme.If you are ready to join an innovative defence industry leader, click Apply Now. Applications Close: Sunday 4 October 2027
